content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Explain why atom economy is important
Compare reactions based on atom economy

measures how efficiently atoms from reactants are converted into the desired product. Unlike percentage yield (which depends on practical factors), atom economy is calculated directly from the equation and represents the theoretical efficiency of a reaction.
is the percentage of the total mass of reactants that forms the desired product.
\text{Atom economy} = \frac{M_r \text{ of desired product}}{\text{Sum of } M_r \text{ of all reactants}} \times 100\%
Many atoms end up in by-products (waste)
All atoms from reactants end up in product
